Fields.Name: Bone Weights
Fields.Description: Weight of the vertex's attachment to bones; must be 4 length.

Fields.Name: Bone Indices
Fields.Description: Bones the vertex is weighted to, indexing the parent mesh's bone indices; must be 4 length.

Fields.Name: Normal
Fields.Description: Vector pointing away from the surface.

Fields.Name: NormalW
Fields.Description: Fourth component of the normal, read without transforming into a float; used as a bone index for binding to a single bone.

Fields.Name: Tangents
Fields.Description: Vector pointing perpendicular to the normal.

Fields.Name: Bitangent
Fields.Description: Vector pointing perpendicular to the normal and tangent.

Fields.Name: Colors
Fields.Description: Data used for alpha, blending, etc.
